giris.altBaslik: Build a paper town and keep its people happy.
giris.onayMetin: Your saved town will be deleted. The new town starts on a new map.
giris.adim1: Draw roads: one end must touch an existing road.
giris.adim2: Build houses along roads so residents move in.
giris.adim3: Bring water and food with fountains and bakeries: houses grow.
giris.adim4: Houses pay taxes at the end of each day; use them to grow your town.
giris.adim5: If the treasury stays below −50 for 3 days in a row, the town goes bankrupt.
giris.is.koy: Place the selected building / select a building
giris.dokunmatik: 🖱️ Kartonia is designed for mouse and keyboard. Play on a computer for the best experience.
giris.kayitNotu: Your town is saved automatically in this browser.
genel.ipucu: Drag with the left button to move around, right-drag to rotate. Buildings go along roads.
hud.dokumBos: Shown after the first day ends.
hud.tuccarIpucu: The travelling merchant is in town: click to trade
menu.yikimMetin: Click a building or road to demolish it. You get half the cost back. Cutting a forest tree costs coins and gives wood. (X)
menu.yolCiz: Drag with the left button to draw.
detay.evNot: A house grows when all needs of the next level are met for a few days in a row, and shrinks when its current needs are not met. For water, market and school the house must be inside that building's range.
detay.bonusIpucu: While placing, the preview shows when the bonus applies.
detay.yukseltilebilir: Once built, it can be upgraded up to level 3 from the info panel; each level widens its range.
bilgi.ormanAgaciMetin: A natural forest tree. Gives wood when cut down.
bilgi.kirCicegiMetin: A natural meadow flower. Bees love it; an Apiary built next to it makes more honey.
bilgi.anitNot: Aura, upkeep and the goal start once the tower is finished.
bilgi.tasYetmiyor: Not enough stone: build a Quarry.
bilgi.yolBagliUzun: Buildings depend on this road; it cannot be demolished.
bilgi.buyumekIcinAyni: No new needs: it grows once this level’s needs are met for a few days.
hedef.efsaneMetin: All goals complete. Keep growing your town.
hedef.1.aciklama: Produce your first food at a bakery or fishery.
hedef.4.aciklama: Reach 150 population and finish the Clock Tower.
hedef.6.aciklama: Reach 200 population with average happiness of at least 70.
hedef.8.aciklama: Upgrade a Market and a School to level 3.
hedef.9.aciklama: Hold 150 food and 100 wood in storage at the same time.
hedef.10.aciklama: Save up 1000 coins in the treasury.
hedef.14.aciklama: Reach 400 population with average happiness of at least 75.
istek.senlik.aciklama: The residents want a festival: deliver {yemek} food from storage. Reward: +{mutluluk} happiness for every house for {gun} days.
istek.kisHazirligi.aciklama: Have {odun} wood in storage. Reward: {odul} coins.
istek.susuzEv.aciklama: Get water to a house (build a Fountain nearby). Reward: {odul} coins.
istek.senlikYapildi: 🎉 Festival held! +{mutluluk} happiness for every house for {gun} days.
tuccar.fiyatNotu: Fixed prices; selling pays less than buying. Each button trades {n} units.
kart.secimBaslik: 📅 Day {gun}: choose your town's character ({sira} / {toplam}). The choice is permanent.
kart.agirVergi.eksi: Houses need 3 good days to grow instead of 2
ogretici.1.metin: In the bottom menu choose Roads → Dirt Road. Drag with the left button next to the starting road to draw a new road: one end must touch an existing road.
ogretici.2.baslik: 2. Place a house by the road
ogretici.2.metin: Choose Housing → House and click right next to a road. Buildings can only go along roads; the house turns to face the road on its own.
ogretici.3.metin: Build Services → Fountain near your houses. The ring on the ground is its range: houses inside get water. Houses with water and food grow.
ogretici.4.baslik: 4. Wait for the day to end
ogretici.4.metin: A day lasts 15 seconds (the bar at the top). When it ends every house pays taxes: golden numbers rise above the houses. Hover over Coins to see the day's summary.
ogretici.5.metin: The card at the top left shows your next goal. Completing goals unlocks new buildings and cards that shape your town. Have fun!
bildirim.yukseldi: {bina} upgraded to level {seviye}; its range grew.
bildirim.kotaDoldu: Trade allowance for this visit is used up.
bildirim.depoDolu: Storage is full. Build a Warehouse.
bildirim.tuccarYok: The merchant is not in town today.
bildirim.senlikYemekYok: Not enough food in stock for the festival.
bildirim.asamaParaYok: Not enough coins for this stage.
bildirim.agacParaYok: Not enough coins to cut the tree.
bildirim.evKuculdu: A house's needs were not met; it shrank.
bildirim.evlerKuculdu: {n} houses' needs were not met; they shrank.
bildirim.efsane: 🏆 All goals complete: your town is a legend! The game goes on.
bildirim.tuccarGeldi: 🛒 The travelling merchant has arrived! Staying {gun} days; use the button in the top bar to trade.
bildirim.tuccarGidiyor: 🛒 The merchant leaves tomorrow: last day to trade.
bildirim.borc: Treasury below {sinir}! ({gun}/{toplam} days) — bankruptcy is near.
uyari.kuculenIpucu: Click: go to the next house
bildirim.kisGeliyor: 🍂 Winter comes in {n} days. Stock up on food and wood.
son.metin: The treasury stayed in debt for too long.
sebep.cakisiyor: Too close to another building or tree.
sebep.yolYok: Must be placed next to a road.
sebep.baglantisiz: The road must connect to an existing road.
sebep.golYok: The Fishery must be built on a lakeshore.
sebep.taslikYok: The Quarry must be built on rocky ground.
sebep.tas: Not enough stone. Build a Quarry.
sebep.odun: Not enough wood. Build a Woodcutter or cut a tree.
sebep.mobilya: Not enough furniture. Build a Carpenter.
sebep.kilitli: This building is not unlocked yet.
bina.ev.aciklama: Residents live here and pay taxes. Grows when its needs are met.
bina.agac.aciklama: Makes nearby houses happy. Woodcutters need trees.
bina.cicek.aciklama: Makes nearby houses a little happier. Bees love flowers: an Apiary next to them makes more honey.
bina.cesme.aciklama: Supplies water to houses in its range.
bina.degirmen.aciklama: Turns wheat into flour. A bit noisy.
bina.firin.aciklama: Bakes bread (food) from flour and sells food to houses in its range.
bina.oduncu.aciklama: Collects wood from every tree in its range. Noisy.
bina.pazar.aciklama: Gives houses in its range market access and sells stored food.
bina.okul.aciklama: Brings education and happiness to houses in its range.
bina.saatKulesi.aciklama: The town landmark. Starts as scaffolding and rises in four stages as you send materials; once finished it spreads happiness over a wide area.
bina.hastane.aciklama: Brings healthcare and happiness to houses in its range.
bina.park.aciklama: Lawns, a pond and benches. Makes houses in range much happier.
bina.hamam.aciklama: Gives houses in range a bathhouse. Mansions need one.
bina.tiyatro.aciklama: Gives houses in range culture and entertainment. Manors need a theatre.
bina.ambar.aciklama: Raises the storage limit of every good by 100.
bina.balikci.aciklama: Built on a lakeshore, catches fish (food). Makes less than a bakery but needs no production chain.
bina.tasOcagi.aciklama: Built on rocky ground, mines stone. Stone is used to upgrade service buildings. Noisy.
bina.marangoz.aciklama: Makes furniture from wood. Two-storey houses need furniture.
bina.agil.aciklama: Raises sheep: turns wheat into wool. A little smelly.
bina.dokumaci.aciklama: Weaves wool into cloth. Mansions need cloth.
bina.arilik.aciklama: Collects honey from the hives; the bees sleep in winter. Manors need honey.
yol.toprak.aciklama: Cheap path. Buildings are placed along roads.
yol.asfalt.aciklama: Expensive but smooth. Houses along it are happier.
komsuluk.ev.sart: center within 5 units of a lake
komsuluk.tarla.sart: edge within 4 units of a lake
